slides.title: Enterprise AI Platform for Care Management
slides.subtitle: Proposal for Acme Health Plan (synthetic sample) · March 2027

slides.title: Our understanding of your challenges
bullets: Care managers review claims and clinical notes by hand in a legacy portal
Prior authorization turnaround averages nine days
Clinical and claims data live in separate systems with nightly batch feeds
HIPAA, HITRUST and CMS-0057 obligations shape every design choice
slides.speaker_notes: Lead with the nine-day prior authorization figure.

slides.title: From manual review to assisted decisions
after: Prior authorization decisions in days, not weeks
One governed view of clinical and claims data

slides.title: Solution architecture
sources: [3 Scope of Work > 3.1 Data Integration, p.2]

slides.title: AI enablement advantages
bullets: Pre-built clinical document understanding shortens time to value
Human-in-the-loop review keeps clinicians in control
Reusable components cut the cost of each new use case

slides.title: A complete AI platform
bullets: Development: notebooks, prompt workbench and evaluation harness
MLOps / LLMOps: versioned models, prompts and pipelines
Observability: quality, drift and cost dashboards
Governance: model registry, approvals and audit trail

slides.title: Responsible AI, security and compliance
bullets: HIPAA safeguards: encryption, access control and audit logging
Controls mapped to the HITRUST CSF
Bias, safety and quality reviews before each release
